 # GDG DevFest Season 2018
Aug 1 - Nov 30, Global

 GDG DevFests are large, community-run developer events happening around the globe focused on community building and learning about Google’s technologies.

 # GDG DevFest Catania 2018
Dec[masked], Catania

 GDG DevFest Catania 2018 is our annual all-day developer conference that offers speaker sessions across multiple product areas, codelabs, hackathon and more, a conference run every year in Southern Italy involving many italian GDGs focusing not only on Google technologies -- we focus on: development/design/marketing methodologies, tools, and platforms; UX / UI design; non-Google technologies; competition, inspiring, and team building sessions; entertainment and prize games; and so on.

 The event's program is still a work in progress but... we are working hard to make this event something you will not forget so soon ;-)

 # Code of conduct

 Please, be sure to read our participation policy before taking part in the event ----> https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FSR-yJxp0qcD4XokQrYtTe-nQJksKLO14vwZRG2jJpM/edit?usp=sharing

 Thank you
